name: JavaScript
create: JavaScript developed by Brendan Eich in 1995 and is primarily used for web development.
advantage: Versatile and widely used for both front-end and back-end development.
disadvantage: Can be challenging to debug and maintain in large applications.

name: Python
create: Python language created by Guido van Rossum and first released in 1991.
advantage: Great for beginners, extensive libraries, and strong community support.
disadvantage: Slower execution speed compared to compiled languages.

name: Java
create: The JavaScript programming language was developed by Brendan Eich in 1995.
advantage: Platform-independent, strong memory management, and robust security features.
disadvantage: Verbose syntax and slower performance compared to some other languages.

name: C Language
create: C is a general-purpose, language developed by Dennis Ritchie at Bell Labs in 1972.
advantage: Efficient and fast execution, low-level memory manipulation, and wide system compatibility.
disadvantage: Manual memory management, lack of built-in error checking, and limited abstraction.

name: C++
create: C++ is an extension of the C programming language, developed by Bjarne Stroustrup in 1983.
advantage: Supports object-oriented programming, high performance, and extensive libraries.
disadvantage: Complex syntax, manual memory management, and potential for undefined behavior.

name: Reactjs
create: React is a JavaScript library for building user interfaces, developed by Facebook.
advantage: Component-based architecture, virtual DOM for efficient rendering, and strong community support.
disadvantage: Steep learning curve for beginners, frequent updates, and limited server-side rendering capabilities.
